title: Mirror member is in a degraded state

definition.name: [InterSystems IRIS] Mirror member is in a degraded state on {{host.name}}

description: Tracks the mirror member state of the IRIS instance. A member that leaves the primary, backup, or connected states is no longer participating normally in the mirror, which means failover protection is reduced or absent until the member returns to a healthy state. The query alerts on any deviation of more than one from backup (3), which covers not-initialized (1) alongside the transition, synchronizing, waiting, stopped, and crashed states (5-9). Instances that are not mirror members do not report this metric at all, so the monitor stays silent on them.
